name: Secret scanning MUST be enabled in the repository to ensure proactive detection and remediation of accidental secret exposure.
requirementTitle: Secret scanning MUST be enabled in the repository to ensure proactive detection and remediation of accidental secret exposure.
requirementDescription: Your code repository must automatically scan for passwords, API keys, tokens, certificates, and other secrets so that accidental exposures are detected and fixed quickly.
why:
Developers sometimes accidentally commit secrets to Git repositories. Once committed, the secret becomes part of the Git history and may be exposed to
- Other developers
- Contractors
- Automated repository scanners
- Attackers if the repository is public or compromised
Secret scanning helps catch these mistakes before they become security incidents. Leaked secrets are exploited in real-time and can enable direct attacker access to our systems and data.
tasks: Secret scanning MUST be enabled in the repository to ensure proactive detection and remediation of accidental secret exposure.
